title: CmdPal: Memory Leak With Queries
body:
# Description

The memory of CmdPal itself and extensions increases after every query input. And it would never go down.

# Details

I encountered a serious memory leak issue while developing a CmdPal extension. I found that the same issue exists in [lin-ycv/EverythingCommandPalette](https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingCommandPalette) - this issue was previously opened as https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingCommandPalette/issues/22.

# Behaviour

## Expected
The memory would rise slightly by query, but should decrease when next query comes since GC collected ListItems from previous query.

## Actual
The memory keeps rising with queries.

# Infomation

## System
OS: Windows 11 Pro 
Version: 24H2 (26100.4061)
Language: zh_CN

## .NET
Target Framework: net9.0-windows10.0.22621.0

## PowerToys
Version: v0.91.1 (Latest)
System Installation
Running as admin

# Reproduction Procedure

1. Start CmdPal
2. Navigate to extension page (In this case would be [EverythingCommandPalette](https://github.com/lin-ycv/EverythingCommandPalette) and my underdeveloping extension) which uses `DynamicListPage`.
3. Type something in to start a query
4. Wait until the results come up
5. Redo steps 3,4 for times, you will notice the issue

# Possible Causes

Difference between the snapshots reveals that the counts such as `Windows.Foundation.TypedEventHandler<Object, Microsoft.CommandPalette.Extensions.PropChangedEventArgs>` and `WinRT.EventRegistrationTokenTable` significantly increase with queries. This indicates that event handlers might be registered (subscribed) but not unregistered (unsubscribed) when they are no longer needed.

I will continue to investigate this issue and update further details.
